neo2-mini5.performance_role: latency/correctness only; not a throughput or scaling case

ldlt-chain.matrix_class: real symmetric indefinite with paired zero-diagonal pivots

contract.scaling_size_rule: Scan frozen candidate levels ascending using external comparators only. A level passes only after every declared backend/thread/trial completes cold factor+normal RHS8 below 0.5 seconds process wall. Stop at first refused/failed/missing/timeout/slow attempt in a family; retain it and mark all higher levels unmeasured. Select the largest completely passing level in the scanned prefix; native timings never select size.

oracle.source: known x and independent original-CSC action; training mini5 reproduces retained all-ones RHS

mkl.reference_sections: PARDISO mtype table printed p2653; iparm(12) transpose table; CSR upper-triangle storage
mkl.panua_status: not available in this driver; distinct licensed comparator remains a gap

memory.process: process_metrics.c VmHWM/rusage peak; parent/helper separate; do not sum RSS
memory.owned: library host_current_bytes/host_peak_bytes when reported; negative means unavailable
memory.pardiso: iparm memory is vendor-reported; owned payload and actual active factor teams unavailable

native.factor_team: serial reference family is reported explicitly; requested threads are not active threads
native.claims: No tiny-case throughput, scaling or Pareto claim

scan_limits.selection_scope: largest passing scanned prefix; no monotonic-performance assumption or extrapolation beyond failure

umfpack_direct.product: SuiteSparse UMFPACK standalone direct I4 general LU, distinct from FortSparse IPC
umfpack_direct.complex_storage: packed interleaved real/imaginary doubles; NULL Az/Bz/Xz
umfpack_direct.memory: postexec self VmHWM for entire standalone process; vendor Info PEAK_MEMORY * SIZE_OF_UNIT / 1e6 is separate decimal MB, not exact owned payload
umfpack_direct.numeric_refactor: retain Symbolic and defaults; free prior Numeric before recomputing
umfpack_direct.prior_receipts: Earlier four-comparator receipts retain their recorded historical scope; they do not prove the expanded five-comparator selection contract

window_note: Root quiet full matched pruned-LU7e1f123 comparison; all task builds/tests/profiles/renders paused, fixed physical cores0..15; normal workstation and resident LLM services retained, nonexclusivehost. Nativefactorserial. Five-peer external-only sizes frozen beforetuning; all5freshtrials/trainingheldout/RHS8refactor/threadbudgets retained; exact source/runtime/ELFs archived.
